title: Build the CTC loss and its gradient
brief: Extend the target with blanks, run the CTC forward and backward recursions in log space, derive the gradient with respect to the logits, and match torch's ctc_loss on a padded batch.
hints: ext = np.full(2 * len(target) + 1, blank); ext[1::2] = target builds the extended sequence.
Precompute skip = np.zeros(S, bool); skip[2:] = (ext[2:] != blank) & (ext[2:] != ext[:-2]). The s - 2 term enters only where skip is True.
log_probs[:, ext] gives a (T, S) array of each state's emission log probability at every frame.
np.logaddexp(-np.inf, -np.inf) is -np.inf with no warning, so start every table at -np.inf and let unreachable states stay there.
In ctc_backward, combine nxt = log_beta[t + 1] + emit[t + 1] shifted left by 0, 1, and (where skip[s + 2]) 2 states.
Several states share the blank symbol, so scatter gamma into symbol columns with np.add.at(occupancy, (slice(None), ext), gamma).
